componentMappings.title: Route and bootstrap boundary

componentMappings.title: Web plugin registry and contributions
componentMappings.rationale: Plugin manifests, route/view contributions, canvas execution/surface strategies and contribution boundaries.

componentMappings.title: Web query boundary
componentMappings.rationale: Frontend query hooks/read boundaries used to reflect backend state and capabilities.

componentMappings.title: Frontend application services
componentMappings.rationale: Application-facing frontend services and service context boundaries.

componentMappings.title: Frontend interaction stores
componentMappings.rationale: Zustand/UI interaction state; presentation state only, not canonical execution truth.

componentMappings.title: Route views
componentMappings.rationale: Route-level product views composed by the router/plugin registry.

componentMappings.title: Platform health capability
componentMappings.rationale: Frontend capability for platform health/readiness presentation.
